title: IaC Stack Definition Compiler
description: Compiles Infrastructure-as-Code stacks (Terraform, Pulumi, CDK). Enforces: all required input variables declared and typed, all downstream outputs declared, no unresolved references, only allowed providers, no hardcoded credentials.

error_codes.IAC001: iac-spec.json missing or invalid — required: platform, cloud, environments, stateBackend
error_codes.IAC002: Required input variable not declared or missing type annotation
error_codes.IAC003: Output referenced by downstream artifact not declared
error_codes.IAC004: Unresolved module or resource reference in IaC files
error_codes.IAC005: Hardcoded credential, key, or secret value found in IaC source
error_codes.IAC006: Provider not in allowed provider list for this stack policy
error_codes.IAC007: TODO/FIXME/HACK comment found in IaC files
